findings.now: A new romance or high-stakes drama gives you the rush of "Exciting Love", which spikes Phasic Dopamine and puts the armor right back up, so this may not be a good time to jump into a new romance or drama, though there's no need to leave the partner you have.
findings.published: The other kind, "Exciting Love", is the rush of a new romance or high-stakes drama, which spikes Phasic Dopamine and puts the armor right back up.
findings.why: "The other kind" is gone, so the reader no longer sees at once that Exciting Love is the opposite of Boring Love, and the term is now defined as something a romance "gives you" instead of as a kind of love.
